title: FAA to cut flights by 10% at 40 major airports due to government shutdown
summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced Wednesday afternoon that he will be reducing flight capacity by 10% at 40 major airports.

title: FAA Plan to Cut Flights Might Not Be an Utter Nightmare
summary: The US government is aiming to ease the pressure on air traffic controllers suffering shutdown-related woes by curtailing flights. But airlines have experience with this kind of sudden disruption.

title: The FAA is cutting 10% of flights in 40 busy markets to ensure safety during the government shutdown
summary: The Federal Aviation Administration said it was cutting flight capacity by 10% across the 40 busiest markets to ensure safety during the shutdown.
